capabilities: Push a configured folder or tagged notes to a Rootr workspace
Detect write conflicts by re-reading documents and comparing ETags before pushing
Refuse to overwrite documents the plugin did not push itself
Report last sync time, pushed files, and conflicts in a status panel
Support auto-sync on save and a self-hosted Rootr base URL
disambiguation: Not a vault-wide sync tool; it pushes one configured folder or tag one-way to Rootr and never writes back into the vault.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The API key is stored unencrypted in .obsidian/plugins/rootr-sync/data.json. Rootr offers a free plan; paid plans exist for larger teams. v1 is one-directional only, does not convert wikilinks, and does not propagate renames or deletions.
problem: Obsidian vaults are local and private, so sharing just part of a vault with teammates or AI assistants requires manual copying.

relations.evidence: This plugin is a client for that service; it does nothing on its own.

requires.name: Rootr API key with docs:read and docs:write scopes

summary: One-way sync client that pushes a chosen folder or tagged notes from your vault into a Rootr cloud workspace for team collaboration.
